history.text: Plan the v7 reindex for shipment search. The port code searches are bad and customers complain. Tell me what you need before running on the full index.

Mapping for shipments_v7 is ready and the dry run on 200,000 documents passed.

## What changed in the mapping
- port_code gets a keyword analyzer, so case no longer matters.
- carrier_aliases is a new field populated from the carrier table.
- eta moves from string to date. Documents with bad strings get a null eta and a flag.
- shipper_raw is removed, nothing reads it.

## Dry run
200,000 documents sampled across all customers. 12 workers, bulk size 2,000. 3m 40s. Extrapolated full run: about 5 hours for 4.1 million documents. CPU stayed at about 55%. Search on v6 was not affected.

## Relevance
Precision at 10 went from 0.81 to 0.87 on the sampled suite. Recall at 50 went from 0.74 to 0.82.

## Cost
Index is about 11% smaller. Overlap of one week between v6 and v7 is budgeted, which is why the retention job on v6 is set to one week after the start of the run.

## Risk notes
The bulk loader treats errors as retryable and I have not exercised a large error rate in the dry run. A sampled run does not prove the rare document shapes. I would check counts after the real run, not only the job status. If counts differ, v6 is still there, so nothing is lost.

## Runbook
The alias swap is atomic. Rollback is the same swap in reverse while v6 exists. The runbook has the low-traffic point at 06:10.

## Other
Relevance suite now runs in CI on the branch. PR #588 is open as a draft with the switch script and the query changes. Marek is reviewing.

## Decision I need
The full run needs a 5 hour window with low write traffic. Two windows work: Saturday 22:00, but that overlaps the Corvid Cargo bulk import, which would make the job slower and may push past 5 hours; or Sunday 01:00, which is clean. Which window do you want? I will not start until you pick.
Add exponential backoff to the Tollgate webhook retries. Fixed 30 second retries are hammering them during outages. Include a dead-letter table.
On it. I will replace the fixed retry with exponential backoff and jitter, add a dead-letter table with admin replay, and write the tests. I will report when CI is green.
